visual_identity.core_identity: A massive bull-headed humanoid defined by sweeping horns, hooves, powerful movement, and a heavy axe.
visual_identity.silhouette: Very broad shoulders, bull head with wide horns, thick humanoid torso, powerful legs ending in hooves, two-handed axe.
visual_identity.head_features: Bull head with long muzzle, flared nostrils, heavy brow, bovine ears, large curved horns.
visual_identity.body_shape: Large muscular humanoid torso and arms with powerful legs and hooved feet; animal head only, not full bull body.
visual_identity.surface: Short sparse body hair with simple hide areas; no dense fur.
